class.name: PreloadList
class.brief_description: A resource that names resources to load once and keep in memory.

method.name: is_empty
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the list names no resource, path or manifest.

members.member: Extra names for the preloaded resources: keys as keys, paths as values. A key can be used instead of the path in [method ResourceDatabase.get_resource] and matches patterns in [method ResourceDatabase.select]. Keys that are not paths are only known to [ResourceDatabase], not to [method ResourceLoader.load].
File manifests whose files are preloaded. Their [member FilesManifest.type_hint] is used as the type hint when it is a native class.
Paths of resources to preload. [code]uid://[/code] paths and the prefixes of [PathPrefixServer] can be used.
Resources to store directly, under their resource path, or under their [member Resource.resource_name] if they have no path.
